[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Service-tree usage-window collection with adaptive, provider-safe [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]refresh[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Periodic usage-window collection runs inside the scheduler service [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]tree (a dedicated `usage` routine whose job probes inline) and no [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]longer creates periodic proc rows. Usage windows refresh sooner [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]where the numbers actually move (a 60 s routine tick plus a "hot" [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]cadence for providers in use). Per-provider polling floors, jitter,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]honored Retry-After, and reason-aware backoff keep every provider [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from being overwhelmed. Each provider's collection errors are [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]classified, surfaced with a retry time, and recovered from without [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]blanking last-known-good windows.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase-core: reason-aware attempt recording and rate-limit [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]policy[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core-attempt-policy[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-attempt-policy: in the linked sase-core repo, add the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`rate_limited` reason code, an optional observation [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`retry_after_seconds`, reason-aware backoff classes behind an opt-in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`adaptive` attempt flag (Retry-After clamping, rate-limit escalation, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]parking, 1 h drift park, 60 s explicit cooldown), collector-health [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`retry_at`/`last_failure_reason`, and pruning of superseded-generation [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]schedule rows. Legacy requests must behave exactly as they do today.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase-core: floors, jitter, parking, hot cadence, and [/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]reservation reads in admission[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core-admission-policy[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-attempt-policy[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-admission-policy: extend due/admit evaluation (opt-in via [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`adaptive` and new optional request fields) with per-provider polling [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]floors, deterministic ±10% jitter, CLI-fingerprint unparking, and hot [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cadence (hot hints, warn-level windows, passive-coverage suppression). [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Add a `mark_provider_usage_hot` store operation, a read-only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]live-reservation listing, and per-provider floor-aware freshness on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reads, all with bindings and golden legacy-compat tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Probe and runner robustness fixes[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]probe-robustness[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]probe-robustness: fix the runner's batch-deadline double-record, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]probe TypeError re-run, the process-tree kill gap, the worker env [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]allowlist, the 2 s agy/grok version timeouts, Muse's missed-mint [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]blanking, and Codex's best-effort `account/read` poisoning the session. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Each fix gets a regression test. This phase is pure Python and needs no [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]core change.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rate-limit classification and reason-aware attempt plumbing[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]rate-limit-plumbing[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-attempt-policy, probe-robustness[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rate-limit-plumbing: move the core pin, add a shared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rate-limit/Retry-After classifier that every collector consults, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]normalize `not_installed`, and pass the reason code, Retry-After, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`adaptive=True` into every recorded attempt. Render the new [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]collector-health retry information in `sase usage list -v` and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Models panel, and update the usage docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Plugin polling floors, CLI fingerprints, and limit events that[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]only mark due[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]adaptive-admission[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-admission-policy, rate-limit-plumbing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]adaptive-admission: move the core pin, let plugins declare [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`min_probe_interval_seconds` (claude 300, muse 180, agy/grok/codex 120),[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]compute CLI fingerprints, and pass floors, fingerprints, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`adaptive=True` through admission, attempts, and floor-aware reads. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Limit events only mark providers due and no longer force explicit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]probes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Dedicated `usage` scheduler routine that probes inline[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]usage-routine[dim] · [dim][/dim]after adaptive-admission[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]usage-routine: move `usage_refresh` out of `checks` into a new 60 s [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`usage` routine whose job runs the admitted batch in-process under [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]non-proc operation IDs. Store-based waiting replaces proc waits for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]joiners (CLI and Models panel). The TUI fallback runs only when the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scheduler does not own collection, `u` toasts render real receipt [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reasons, and the tests and docs are updated to match.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Hot cadence for providers in active use[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hot-cadence[dim] · [dim][/dim]after usage-routine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hot-cadence: add `llm_provider.usage_metrics.active_refresh_seconds` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](default 120), pass the active cadence and warn percent into admission, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and write best-effort 15-minute hot hints from the agent launch path and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]limit events. Update the config schema, defaults, and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]CLI capability cache for usage probes[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]capability-cache[dim] · [dim][/dim]after adaptive-admission[/#AF87FF][/dim]
